title.zh: Coinbase Files SEC Notices in Bid to Bring Single-Stock Perpetuals to US
title.en: Coinbase Files SEC Notices in Bid to Bring Single-Stock Perpetuals to US

current_state.zh: Coinbase has filed SEC notices to offer single-stock perpetuals in the US, aiming to expand its equity-derivatives lineup beyond thematic indexes, with CFTC approval as the next step.
current_state.en: Coinbase has filed SEC notices to offer single-stock perpetuals in the US, aiming to expand its equity-derivatives lineup beyond thematic indexes, with CFTC approval as the next step.
